research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12864 (58 FR 48773, PDF pages 193-194 of the 1993-09-17 issue; sha256 8eb39d81...), headed Executive Order 12864 of September 15, 1993, United States Advisory Council on the National Information Infrastructure, matching the census register row (1993-09-15). Text and inventory: 21 scopes cover sections 1 through 4(c) to the signature, with the ten items of section 2(b) as separate scopes; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory council. Ending: the Council's own term as replaced by Executive Order 12970 ended it on June 1, 1996 unless otherwise extended, and no held instrument extends it; Executive Order 13062 section 3(d) later revokes the order as amended, effective September 30, 1997. Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

(3) A search of the held corpus for the number 12864 found Executive Orders 12890, 12921, 12970 and 13062 and the order's own texts (the machine match to Executive Order 12960 is an unrelated number match); the OFR disposition-note machine search lists nine hits, the same instruments. savings.reason: Executive Order 13062 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the United States Advisory Council on the National Information Infrastructure: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
